title: Date input
overview: Collect a date: memorable split fields, a single field, and/or a calendar when weekday context helps.
apply_when: Birthday, appointment, start/end of a period, any date the service needs.
not_when: Time of day alone (time_input), or a non-date number.

vs.why: clock time, not a calendar day

role.overview: Three text fields: day, month, year.
role.apply_when: A date they know (date of birth).
role.not_when: A date they must pick from a calendar because they do not know it.

role.overview: A calendar picker, optionally with a text field.
role.apply_when: A booking or a date they do not remember as numbers.
role.not_when: A memorable date forced through a calendar.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Day / month / year as separate labeled fields.
composition.not_when: One unlabeled type=date with no fallback.

composition.overview: One field plus a calendar button.
composition.not_when: A calendar with no typed alternative.

state.overview: At rest, available, not being used.
state.apply_when: The field can take a value now.
state.not_when: The field is invalid, disabled, or work is in flight.

state.overview: Pointer is over the field — extra cue, not the only cue.
state.apply_when: A mouse or trackpad can reach the field.
state.not_when: Hover is the only way to know it is editable.

state.overview: Keyboard or assistive tech is on this field. Must stay visible.
state.apply_when: Tab, click, or restoring focus after an error jump.
state.not_when: Focus outline removed with no replacement.

state.overview: The field is not available. Must stay perceivable and explain why.
state.apply_when: A value that must not change on this view.
state.not_when: A required answer on a public form — keep it enabled and explain on submit.

state.overview: The value failed a check. The field stays named and described.
state.apply_when: After validate; helper or error text is tied to this field.
state.not_when: A page banner with no field association (error_summary without the field).

accessibility.overview: The field has a name assistive tech can speak — usually a visible label.
accessibility.apply_when: Any input, especially placeholder-only or icon-prefixed fields.
accessibility.not_when: The only name is placeholder or a tooltip that never reaches the input.

accessibility.overview: The focused field stays visible. Color alone is not the cue.
accessibility.apply_when: Keyboard or AT focus is on the field.

accessibility.overview: Unavailable stays in the tab order and explains why.
accessibility.apply_when: The field must not run, but focus must not jump away.
accessibility.not_when: The HTML disabled attribute, which drops the control from the keyboard flow.

accessibility.overview: Helper, hint, or error is tied to the field so AT speaks it with the name.
accessibility.apply_when: Hint text, character count, or a field error.
accessibility.not_when: A page-level message with no aria-describedby / for= on this field.

accessibility.overview: The hit area stays usable, including the label.
accessibility.apply_when: Touch, pointer, or a compact form.
accessibility.not_when: A 16px box whose tap area is the glyph only.

accessibility.overview: The group has a name (legend) when the date is split.
accessibility.not_when: Three fields with no group name.

keyboard.overview: Tab lands on the field in a logical order.
keyboard.not_when: The control is skipped because it used HTML disabled.

keyboard.overview: Enter submits the form when this is a single-line field, or confirms in a dialog.
keyboard.apply_when: A text-like field in a form or overlay.
keyboard.not_when: Enter inserts a newline (textarea) or only works on a button.

keyboard.overview: In a calendar grid, arrows move the day.
keyboard.not_when: Arrows skip weeks with no name.

keyboard.overview: Escape closes the calendar and returns to the field.
